application_deadline.description: As published on the official page (e.g. '15 Oct 2026', '13 Jan 2027'). Null = not stated / unknown. Never invent a date.

application_status.description: Only from an official admissions/deadline page that states whether applications are open or closed for the current cycle. Anything else is 'unknown'.

application_status_as_of.description: Date the status was checked (YYYY-MM-DD). Required unless status is 'unknown' with no source.

application_status_source.description: Official URL that states the status. Required when status is open/closed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the institution (any country — the expansion is global).

duration.description: As published, e.g. '4 years', '12 months', '90 credits'.

duration_months.description: Normalised months where the source states a duration in months/years. Null when the source gives credits only or no duration.

fees.description: One fee record for the international/residency fee as published. amount null = not stated (unknown), never invented; notes must then say so. period 'per_credit' is for US credit-priced programmes.

academic_year.description: e.g. '2026/27', '2026-27'. Null if the page does not tie the fee to a year.

amount_max.description: Top of a published range (e.g. lab vs non-lab). Null when not a range.

amount_min.description: Bottom of a published range. Null when not a range.

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. USD, GBP, SGD, CHF, EUR, HKD, AUD.

notes.description: Human-readable fee note, e.g. 'Tuition 2026/27, international, per year. Domestic USD 59,000.'

residency.description: Which residency the amount applies to.

field.description: Controlled field slug for filtering. Use the closest one; 'other-computing' only when none fits.

field_zh.description: Chinese field name, e.g. 计算机科学 / 数据科学 / 人工智能.

id.description: Unique across v2 + expansion. Convention: <institution-slug>-<field-slug>-<degree-slug>-<intake-year>, e.g. mit-cs-sb-2027.

institution_id.description: Must match an id in data/versions/v2/rankings.json institutions.

matchable.description: Always false in the expansion file. A programme becomes matchable only after engine rules + tests exist for it; that is a separate, per-programme promotion, never a bulk flag.

name_localized.description: Presentation-layer display names (degree part only). zh-CN is required, using the standard degree-name convention (BSc=理学学士, MSc=理学硕士, BEng=工程学士, MEng=工程硕士, SB=理学学士, AB=文学学士, MS=理学硕士, MA=文学硕士, Hons=荣誉). Other locales only where a standard translation exists; missing locales fall back to official_name. Never overwrites official_name.

official_name.description: Degree title exactly as published on the official programme page.

requirements.description: Same shape as data/schemas/requirement.json. Record the full requirement set the eligibility engine needs later: academic (threshold where stated, null otherwise), language (IELTS/TOEFL), test (admissions tests, e.g. TMUA, SAT/ACT policy). A requirement with no stated threshold has threshold null and a description that says so.

sources.description: Same shape as data/schemas/source.json. At least one official programme page. US undergraduate programmes share central admissions facts — cite the central admissions page as the source on each programme; never invent a per-major threshold.

subject.description: Same value as field (kept for the v2 filter contract).
